summary: Jefferies Financial Group Inc. filed a 424B5 pricing supplement for the issuance of $1.283 million in Senior Leveraged Barrier Notes linked to the worst-performing of two underlyings (EEM ETF and EURO STOXX 50 Index). The notes are senior unsecured obligations under its medium-term note program, pay no interest, and offer leveraged upside (302% participation) with principal protection unless the worst-performing underlying falls below 70% of its initial value, at which point investors suffer a 1% loss per 1% decline. This is a routine structured note offering, not a special situation.
